en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ibn Mahboub – similar to it. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, raising it, (It has been narrated) from one of the companions of Abu Abdullahasws, I guess it was Abu Aasim Al-Sajistany

who said, ‘I was a fellow traveller of Abdullah Bin Al-Najjashy, and he viewed by the opinion of Al-Zaydiyya. So when we were at Al-Medina, he went to Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan (Al Basry), and I went to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So when I left, I saw him gloomy. So when it was the morning he said to me, ‘Get me permission to (see) Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and said, ‘Abdullah Bin Al-Najjashy, who views by the opinions of Al-Zaydiyya, and he had gone to Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan, and has asked me that I seek permission for him, to (see) you<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said; ‘Give permission to him’.

So he came over to him<sup>asws</sup>, so he said, ‘O son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! I am a man who has befriended you<sup>asws</sup>, and I am saying that the truth is among you<sup>asws</sup>, and I have killed seven from the ones whom I heard insulting Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>. So I asked Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan about that, so he said to me, ‘You will be seized for their blood in the world and the Hereafter’. So I said, ‘So why do the people antagonise me when I am to be seized with the blood of the one I hear insulting Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup>?’

So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘So how did you kill them?’ He said, ‘Among them was one whom there was a gathering between me and him, on the road, so I killed him. And among them was one whom I went over to, in his house, so I killed him, and that is concealed (matter) upon me, all of it’.

So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘O Abu Jidash! It is upon you, with each man you killed from them, a ram. You should slaughter it at Mina, because you killed them without permission from the Imam<sup>asws</sup>. And had you kill them with the permission of the Imam<sup>asws</sup>, there would not happen to be upon you anything in the world and the Hereafter’.
